monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The active conversion improvement is the product-neutral vape end-of-life checkout screen: exact identity, power system, service life, return and recall route, verified disposal path, and total burden must all survive before purchase. No brand, merchant, product, live price, stock, discount, rating, fabricated test, or product image was added; repair, a supported reusable system, a non-inhaled lawful option, or no purchase remains valid.

image_qa.note: The new menopause asset and expanded vape-disposal asset use original text, evidence tables, checklists, records, and existing interface assets. No patient, cannabis product, vape, battery, cartridge, affiliate, stock, generated, or third-party image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing ambiguity was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 26–November 22 report is one day old and valid: 796 impressions, four clicks, 0.503% CTR, and average position 18.966. The established vape-disposal URL had 19 impressions, one click, 5.26% CTR, and average position 8.895, so the Data-led action materially expands that exact page instead of creating a cannibalizing disposal URL. Blue Dream signals were already reinforced on November 17 and sit around positions 49–55; Arkansas and Delaware legal rows belong to already-served or weekly legal-review work; home-page, chronic-pain HTTP, and one- or two-impression queries were too weak, stale, navigational, or duplicative. Those signals were deliberately ignored.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready menopause evidence asset that maps systematic-review, clinical-guideline, survey, society, NIH, and FDA evidence to explicit transfer limits; added reciprocal paths from the health-evidence, medicine-interaction, sleep, and clinician-conversation cluster. The vape expansion adds a format-specific disposal matrix, locally verifiable handoff receipt, and evidence-based end-of-life purchase screen. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent; improving the asset and its crawl paths was the higher-value authority action.
